The '''Zero-G Club''' was a dance club on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. It offered three [[Zero-G]] domes, with each dome playing a different style of popular [[Music/Legends|Music]].<ref name="Cloud Cover" />

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent [[Tereez Tey'flah]] frequented the club.<ref name="Cloud Cover" />
